model_scope.literal: Concatenate original full SLP1 components unchanged; residual length 1..6 SLP1 letters and at least one vowel. Preserve literal attestation and support.
model_scope.limited_join: At every component boundary, retain the literal join and optionally apply only: final m before a consonant -> anusvara M or the corresponding stop-row nasal; a/A + a/A -> A; i/I before a heterogeneous vowel -> y; i/I + i/I -> I. Apply the same boundary rules to all rivals. No aspiration, voicing, retroflexion, consonant deletion, morphological stems, arbitrary edit distance or global phonological normalization.
model_scope.sam_specific: Anusvara option is permitted before consonants; homorganic options are N for kKgGN, Y for cCjJY, R for wWqQR, n for tTdDn and m for pPbBm. A forward join must reproduce an exact dictionary headword.
model_scope.inverse_scope: Generate underlying residual candidates only by inversion of the stated finite boundary rules; forward-verify every recovered candidate. No claim of full Sanskrit sandhi coverage.

new_anchor_productivity.scope: Two-component dictionary-productivity stress test for semantic comparison words; no corpus sound assignment.

controls.type: Uniform samples without replacement from distinct alphabetic MW headwords of identical SLP1 length to each tested anchor stem; reused sample for each length across anchors/orientations/models.
controls.rng: Python random.Random independent of positional permutations and earlier run RNG; earlier sampled controls were not persisted as identities.

interpretation: Exact dictionary support and rival ranks measure the declared search model. They are not probabilities of ancient readings. Limited joins repair named literal failures without supplying general Sanskrit morphology.
